# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 2: Act II Foundation of Nova Elysia — Senate, Constitution, Culture & Natives (oe_eln_, Slot 73). Generated by gen_elysia_nation.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Canonical Nova Elysia host check (accepts both W1 contract variable
# oe_ely_is_elysia and blueprint alias oe_ely_is_nova_elysia; strictly rebel-guarded).
oe_eln_is_elysia = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
	}
}

# Country scope. Native policy branch helpers (1 = Foederati, 2 = Limes).
oe_eln_is_foederati_path = {
	has_variable = oe_eln_native_path
	var:oe_eln_native_path ?= 1
}

oe_eln_is_limes_path = {
	has_variable = oe_eln_native_path
	var:oe_eln_native_path ?= 2
}

# Country scope. Bare-key policy helpers (no scope prefix on has_policy).
oe_eln_uses_foederati_law = {
	has_policy = oe_eln_pol_foederati_civitas
}

oe_eln_uses_limes_law = {
	has_policy = oe_eln_pol_colonial_limes
}

oe_eln_uses_asylum_law = {
	has_policy = oe_eln_pol_open_asylum
}

# Country scope. Chesapeake bridgehead ownership check (has_owner = yes + owner = prev).
oe_eln_has_chesapeake_core = {
	OR = {
		location:chesapeake = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner = prev
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner = prev
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Northern expansion hub (Manhattan / Nea Athenai).
oe_eln_has_northern_hub = {

		has_owner = yes
		owner = prev
	}
}

# Country scope. Southern expansion hub (Roanoke / Croatan / Nea Mystras).
oe_eln_has_southern_hub = {

			has_owner = yes
			owner = prev
		}
		location:croatan = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner = prev
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Tobacco / maize cash-crop corridor ownership check.
oe_eln_has_cash_crop_hub = {
	OR = {
		location:anacostia = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner = prev
		}
		location:pamunkey = {
			has_owner = yes
			owner = prev
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Readiness for Elysian Greek ethnogenesis (25 years settled & >= 5 American locations).
oe_eln_ready_for_ethnogenesis = {
	oe_eln_is_elysia = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ethnogenesis_done }
	has_variable = oe_eln_months_settled
	var:oe_eln_months_settled >= 300
	any_owned_location = {
		count >= 5
		continent = continent:america
	}
}

# Country scope. Readiness for Act II Coming of Age milestone (>= 15 American locations).
oe_eln_ready_for_consolidation = {
	oe_eln_is_elysia = yes
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_consolidation_done }
	has_variable = oe_eln_senate_convened
	has_variable = oe_eln_native_path
	any_owned_location = {
		count >= 15
		continent = continent:america
	}
}
